title: Restore missing “Add Availability” button on day detail popup/page

requirements.text: Restore an “Add Availability” button that is always visible when viewing a specific day’s availability details (the day detail view reached by clicking a date on the calendar), positioned above the availability list inside the day detail content area.

quotes: Okay i noticed that when I click a date on the calendar, the day pops up showing users availability, however the button to add availability to that day has dissappeared

1)always appear
2)inside the day pop up above availability list
3)restored how it was

acceptanceCriteria: When navigating to a day detail view from the calendar, an “Add Availability” button is visible without requiring any additional interactions.
The “Add Availability” button is displayed above the list of users’ availability entries within the day detail UI.
The button label is exactly “Add Availability” (English user-facing text).

requirements.text: Ensure the day detail “Add Availability” button routes to the existing add/edit availability screen for the selected day, passing the currently selected day as the date search parameter so the form opens on that day.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the day detail “Add Availability” button navigates to “/add-availability” and includes the selected day as a search parameter (e.g., search.date).
On the Add/Edit Availability page, the displayed date matches the day the user clicked from the calendar.
No backend/canister changes are required for this navigation behavior.

requirements.text: Show the day detail “Add Availability” button even when the selected day currently has no availability entries (the empty-state view).
acceptanceCriteria: If a day has zero availability entries, the day detail screen still displays the “Add Availability” button above the empty-state message.
The empty-state message remains visible and readable, and the button remains clearly discoverable above it.

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose existing UI components instead).
Do not edit immutable frontend hook files: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx.
Keep backend as a single Motoko actor; no backend changes are required for this fix.
nonGoals: Do not redesign the calendar month view or change how dates are selected.
Do not change availability data models, persistence, or access control.
Do not add new authentication providers or identity flows.
